Landed in `.claudinite/local/packs/claudinite-website/RULES.md` (the repo's only local pack).

- Self-descriptions moving with behaviour (#36, #45) — two existing RULES.md rules cover it.
- static-website adoption (#60/#61) and its settings-only prerequisites (#62) — in flight, unmerged; no settled lesson yet.
- #40's GENERATED-file "never hand-edit" — canon's `engineering-practices` skill covers GENERATED discipline.

- One commit on per-run branch `claude/growth-extract-2026-08-02`, commit body `Refs #71`.

Logged on **#13 — `Claudinite tracker: Growth Extract`** (found by exact title search; already existed, left closed and otherwise untouched): https://github.com/[REDACTED:env:CCR_TRIGGER_REPO]/issues/13#issuecomment-5155181075 — a dated entry naming the window reviewed, the one rule added and where, what was considered and left out, and the PR/verification.
